_comment: Worked example-2 fine-tuning utility experiment. Inherits config_kr.json and changes nothing but the judge panel, which is pinned to the three judges the base qwen3:8b run (v052-open / v052-closed) actually used. llama3.3:70b is installed on this machine and would otherwise enter the panel, making the fine-tuned runs incomparable to the base they are measured against.
